subject: Medsigo request: prompt-output + logs sanitization — schedule & evidence
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medsigo.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompt outputs, conversation logs, and runtime traces

Hi Ava / Monica,

We need to schedule a complete sanitization for our Medsigo workspace (account id: MED-8821). Scope: all prompt inputs and model outputs generated in the last 18 months, KV-cache artifacts tied to our models, and any request/response logs that contain PHI or customer identifiers. Our compliance team needs a short timeline and a verification package (logs, command list, and an evidence artifact) suitable for an internal audit.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can perform an account-scoped wipe for MED-8821 that covers prompts, outputs, and associated serving logs
- Estimated lead time and blackout windows (if any)
- What evidence you will provide and in what format (sha256 sums, run commands, export of sweep logs)

We’re targeting completion before the end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of Platform & Security
Medsigo Health

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medsigo.com>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@medsigo.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt outputs, conversation logs, and runtime traces

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks for the clear scope. We can handle this; below is our proposed lightweight remediation plan and what you’ll receive as proof. I’ve attached an Erasure Checklist to this reply for your review (erasure_checklist.xlsx).

Summary of proposed plan (high level):
- Confirm exact account identifiers and any model aliases you want excluded (if any).
- Schedule a non-disruptive sweep that:
  * purges prompt inputs and model outputs from prompt-output logs and KV-store snapshots tied to MED-8821,
  * removes aged request/response logs containing customer identifiers (we’ll preserve anonymized aggregates for system health unless you request full deletion),
  * rotates any ephemeral keys used by dedicated serving instances if requested.
- Deliverables: 
  * Evidence bundle: sweep logs (plain text), a signed manifest (sha256 hashes of evidence files), and a short runbook summary (PDF).
  * Ticket with timeline and run commands used.

Tentative timeline: we can kick off pre-checks today and run the sweep within 48–72 business hours after sign-off. Evidence package delivered within 24 hours of completion. If you need completion by next Friday (2026-09-24), we are on track provided there are no unexpected dependencies.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm account id = MED-8821 and any exclusions.
2) Approve the attached checklist or suggest modifications.
3) Confirm a blackout window (if you need us to avoid serving windows for specific hours).

I’m looping in Monica, Rishi, Marcus, and Neha to coordinate the run and evidence collection.

Best,
Ava Chen
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: erasure_checklist.xlsx)
